name: Context Maps Modeler
description: Open .cm and .cm.json files as context maps: model bounded contexts and their relationships, and see an agent's changes to the file as they happen.

cover.alt: Miragon Modeler for Context Maps: Context maps from plain .cm files, edited by you and your agents.

screenshots.alt: A context map of a conference program with core, supporting and generic subdomains connected by ACL, OHS, shared kernel and partnership relationships
screenshots.caption: Bounded contexts and their relationships
